short-en: South Korean pianist Jiyoung Kim, based in Germany, is a prizewinner at major international competitions. She received 3rd Prize at the Maj Lind International Piano Competition and 2nd Prize at the Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy Hochschulwettbewerb, followed by 4th Prize at the 13th International Paderewski Piano Competition. Further distinctions include prizes at the Bösendorfer USASU International Piano Competition, Shigeru Kawai International Piano Competition, the International Tchaikovsky Competition for Young Musicians, the Jacob Flier International Piano Competition, Tallinn International Piano Competition, and the Munich Steinway Competition. She was also awarded the Pnina Salzman Prize at the Tel-Hai International Piano Masterclass.
full-en:
South Korean pianist Jiyoung Kim, based in Germany, is a prizewinner at major international competitions. She received 3rd Prize at the Maj Lind International Piano Competition and 2nd Prize at the Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy Hochschulwettbewerb, followed by 4th Prize at the 13th International Paderewski Piano Competition. Further distinctions include prizes at the Bösendorfer USASU International Piano Competition, Shigeru Kawai International Piano Competition, the International Tchaikovsky Competition for Young Musicians, the Jacob Flier International Piano Competition, Tallinn International Piano Competition, and the Munich Steinway Competition. She was also awarded the Pnina Salzman Prize at the Tel-Hai International Piano Masterclass.

 She made her orchestral debut at the age of nine and has since performed with the Konzerthausorchester Berlin, Helsinki Philharmonic Orchestra, Estonia National Symphony Orchestra, Paderewski Pomeranian Philharmonic Orchestra, MDR Leipzig Radio Symphony Orchestra, State Symphony Orchestra of the Russian Federation “Novaya Russia,” Capella Bydgostiensis, Gyeonggi Philharmonic Orchestra, Gunpo Prime Philharmonic Orchestra, and Suwon Philharmonic Orchestra.

 She gave her solo debut recital at Carnegie Hall and has since appeared at major venues including Gewandhaus Leipzig, Konzerthaus Berlin, Estonia Concert Hall, and the Seoul Arts Center, alongside an active schedule of solo recitals internationally. She was designated as a Gyeonggi Young Artist and has performed as an artist in residence.

 In 2023, she recorded Scriabin’s 12 Études Op. 8 and Ravel’s Miroirs under the auspices of the Internationale Stiftung zur Förderung von Kultur und Zivilisation.

 Kim graduated from Yewon School and Seoul Arts School under Hyerim Kim. She earned her Bachelor of Music with highest distinction from Seoul National University under Prof. Aviram Reichert, and completed her Master’s degree and Zertifikat Meisterklasse with highest distinction at the University of Music and Theatre Munich under Prof. Antti Siirala. She is currently pursuing a Meisterklasse at the University of Music and Theatre “Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy” Leipzig with Prof. Gerald Fauth.

 A recipient of scholarships from the Elfrun-Gabriel Foundation and the Sächsische Landesstipendium, she continues to present solo recitals internationally in 2026.

full-de:
Die südkoreanische Pianistin Jiyoung Kim ist Preisträgerin zahlreicher internationaler Klavierwettbewerbe. Sie erhielt den 3. Preis beim Maj Lind International Piano Competition sowie den 2. Preis beim Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy Hochschulwettbewerb, gefolgt vom 4. Preis beim 13. Internationalen Paderewski Klavierwettbewerb. Weitere Auszeichnungen umfassen Preise beim Bösendorfer USASU International Piano Competition, Shigeru Kawai International Piano Competition, dem Internationalen Tschaikowsky-Wettbewerb für junge Musiker, der Jacob Flier International Piano Competition sowie der Tallinn International Piano Competition. Zudem wurde sie mit dem Pnina-Salzman-Preis bei der Tel-Hai International Piano Masterclass ausgezeichnet.

 Ihr Orchesterdebüt gab sie im Alter von neun Jahren. Seither konzertierte sie mit dem Konzerthausorchester Berlin, dem Helsinki Philharmonic Orchestra, dem Estonian National Symphony Orchestra, der Paderewski Pomeranian Philharmonic Orchestra, dem MDR- Sinfonieorchester Leipzig, dem Staatlichen Sinfonieorchester der Russischen Föderation „Nowaja Rossija“, der Capella Bydgostiensis sowie dem Gyeonggi Philharmonic Orchestra, Gunpo Prime Philharmonic Orchestra und dem Suwon Philharmonic Orchestra.

  Ihr Solodebüt in der Carnegie Hall markierte einen frühen Meilenstein ihrer Laufbahn. Seither trat sie in bedeutenden Konzertsälen wie dem Gewandhaus Leipzig, dem Konzerthaus Berlin, der Estonia Concert Hall und dem Seoul Arts Center auf und gab zahlreiche Solorezitals im In- und Ausland. Sie wurde als „Gyeonggi Young Artist“ ausgezeichnet und war als Artist in Residence tätig.

 Im Jahr 2023 nahm sie Skrjabins 12 Etüden op. 8 sowie Ravels „Miroirs“ unter der Schirmherrschaft der Internationalen Stiftung zur Förderung von Kultur und Zivilisation auf.

 Ihren Bachelor of Music schloss sie mit Auszeichnung an der Seoul National University bei Prof. Aviram Reichert ab. Anschließend erwarb sie ihren Masterabschluss sowie das Zertifikat Meisterklasse mit Auszeichnung an der Hochschule für Musik und Theater München bei Prof. Antti Siirala. Derzeit studiert sie in der Meisterklasse an der Hochschule für Musik und Theater „Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy“ Leipzig bei Prof. Gerald Fauth.

 Sie ist Stipendiatin der Elfrun-Gabriel-Stiftung sowie des Sächsischen Landesstipendiums und konzertiert auch im Jahr 2026 weiterhin international als Solistin.
short-ko: 피아니스트 김지영은 이화경향콩쿠르 우승과 중앙음악콩쿠르·동아음악콩쿠르 3위 수상을 계기로 주목받기 시작했다. 이후 Maj Lind International Piano Competition 3위, Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy Hochschulwettbewerb 2위, 13th International Paderewski Piano Competition 4위를 수상하였으며, Bösendorfer USASU International Piano Competition, Shigeru Kawai International Piano Competition, International Tchaikovsky Competition for Young Musicians, Jacob Flier International Piano Competition, Tallinn International Piano Competition 등 다수의 국제 콩쿠르에서 입상하였다. 또한 Tel-Hai International Piano Masterclass에서 Pnina Salzman Prize를 수상하였다.
full-ko:
피아니스트 김지영은 이화경향콩쿠르 우승과 중앙음악콩쿠르·동아음악콩쿠르 3위 수상을 계기로 주목받기 시작했다. 이후 Maj Lind International Piano Competition 3위, Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy Hochschulwettbewerb 2위, 13th International Paderewski Piano Competition 4위를 수상하였으며, Bösendorfer USASU International Piano Competition, Shigeru Kawai International Piano Competition, International Tchaikovsky Competition for Young Musicians, Jacob Flier International Piano Competition, Tallinn International Piano Competition 등 다수의 국제 콩쿠르에서 입상하였다. 또한 Tel-Hai International Piano Masterclass에서 Pnina Salzman Prize를 수상하였다.

 9세에 오케스트라와 협연으로 데뷔한 이후 Konzerthausorchester Berlin, Helsinki Philharmonic Orchestra, Estonia National Symphony Orchestra, Paderewski Pomeranian Philharmonic Orchestra, MDR Leipzig Radio Symphony Orchestra, 러시아 연방 국립 교향악단 “Novaya Russia”, Capella Bydgostiensis, 경기필하모닉오케스트라, 군포 프라임 필하모닉 오케스트라, 수원시립교향악단 등과 협연하였다.

 카네기홀에서 독주 데뷔 리사이틀을 가진 이후 라이프치히 게반트하우스, 베를린 콘체르트하우스, 에스토니아 콘서트홀, 서울 예술의전당 등 주요 공연장에서 연주하며 국내외 무대에서 활발한 독주 활동을 이어가고 있다. 경기도문화의전당 ‘경기 영아티스트’로 활동하였다.

 2023년에는 Internationale Stiftung zur Förderung von Kultur und Zivilisation의 후원 아래 스크리아빈 〈12 Etudes Op. 8〉과 라벨 〈Miroirs〉를 녹음하였다.

 예원학교와 서울예술고등학교를 졸업하고, 서울대학교 음악대학에서 Aviram Reichert 교수를 사사하며 학사과정을 실기수석으로 졸업하였다. 이후 독일 뮌헨 국립음대(Hochschule für Musik und Theater München)에서 Antti Siirala 교수를 사사하며 석사과정과 Meisterklasse 과정을 최고점으로 졸업하였다. 현재는 라이프치히 국립음대(Hochschule für Musik und Theater „Felix Mendelssohn Bartholdy“ Leipzig)에서 Gerald Fauth 교수 사사로 Meisterklassenexamen 과정에 재학 중이다.

 Elfrun-Gabriel 재단과 작센 주정부 장학금(Sächsische Landesstipendium) 수혜자로 선정되었으며, 2026년에도 국내외 무대에서 연주 활동을 이어가고 있다.
